snippets: Creators must be at least 18 years old (or 19 in South Korea).
Creators must have at least 10,000 followers.
Creators must have at least 100,000 video views in the last 30 days.
Creators must have a Personal Account.
Business Accounts and accounts belonging to political or government organizations aren't eligible.
Creators must post original content that's eligible for rewards.
Creators must post videos that are at least one minute long.
Videos must be uploaded after joining the Creator Rewards Program.
Videos must have at least 1,000 qualified For You feed views.
Videos must be longer than 5 seconds to count as a view.
Original content is quality content that's designed, filmed, and produced by you.
Content that is reproduced from others with only slight modifications, including videos that are sped up or contain filters, fixed texts, or stickers, is not considered original.
Content that contains different videos or pictures originating from other people, creators, or sources without new and personal ideas is not considered original.
Content that contains looping videos, single or multiple photos, or only text overlays is not considered original.
Advertisements, paid promotions, sponsored content, or videos linked to a Series are not allowed in the program.
